summary: 周六的工作集中在 frame 交易的内存池安全和 gas 计算。EIP-8141 的 PR 提出四项规则，减少结构错误交易和共享付款方变更带来的验证放大。EIP-8130 提交修正（16 日合并），让 EIP-7623 的 calldata 下限也适用于其交易类型。binji 等人讨论 ZK KYC 和 zk passport。

items.topic: frame 与 keystore 交易的 gas 和验证规则
items.title: EIP-8141：定义提前拒绝和付款方重验证规则
items.note: （sm-stack）。现有规则可能对已经结构不合格的交易做昂贵验证，或在共享付款方或工厂变更一次后对大量待处理交易重复验证；PR 处理四个验证放大来源，首先是在验签前做编码和静态约束检查。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: define early rejection and payer revalidation rules
items.note_en: (sm-stack). The current rules can require expensive validation for transactions that already fail structural checks, or repeat validation across many pending transactions after one change to a shared payer or factory; the PR addresses four sources of amplification, starting with encoding and static checks before signature verification.

items.title: EIP-8130：在固有 gas 中应用 EIP-7623 calldata 下限
items.note: （chunter-cb，9 月 16 日合并）。8130 交易的字节在 `calls`、`account_changes` 等字段而非 `data`，原先按每字节 16/4 计价且无下限，在采用 EIP-7623 的链上下限从不生效。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: apply the EIP-7623 calldata floor to intrinsic gas
items.note_en: (chunter-cb, merged September 16). An 8130 transaction's bytes live in `calls`, `account_changes` and other fields rather than `data`, and were priced at a flat 16/4 per byte with no floor, so on chains that adopted EIP-7623 the floor never bound.

keywords_en: EIP-8141 early rejection and payer revalidation
summary_en: Saturday's work focused on mempool safety and gas calculation for frame transactions. An EIP-8141 PR proposed four rules to cut validation amplification from malformed transactions and shared payer changes. EIP-8130 submitted a fix (merged on the 16th) so EIP-7623's calldata floor applies to its transaction type too. binji and others discussed ZK KYC and zk passports.
